mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific trigger conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1.0% from 3-month averages signal broad economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with joint HOUST/INDPRO declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% sustained for 3 months), higher borrowing costs reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained retail sales growth (RSAFS > 0.5% YoY) indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days without trigger conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with RSAFS > 0.5% YoY, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month retail sales decline exceeding 1.0% YoY signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) combined with stable federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS >= 1.5%) indicates inadequate monetary policy support for labor market stress, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market stress with inadequate monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the joint condition, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle labor markets (UNRATE < 4.0% declining for 6 months), overheating risks trigger monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
